claim: *Coverage of model correspondence.* Mechanical checks cover only claims the representation makes decidable; semantic claims still require judgment, and unmodeled properties have no model-based coverage.

topology.description: Modeled surface contains decidable and semantic claims; unmodeled region outside; recurring miss feedback dashed.

bw_encoding: Only the named modeled-surface territory uses 5%; its child claims and the unmodeled node remain white.
redesign: Only the named modeled-surface territory uses 5%; its child claims and the unmodeled node remain white. Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
alt: A modeled surface contains two regions: decidable claims receive mechanical checks and semantic claims require judgment. A separate unmodeled region has no model-based coverage. Dashed recurring-miss feedback calls for refining the representation or control.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Distinct gray for mechanically decidable and judgment claims. Dashed unmodeled boundary and recurring-miss feedback retained.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors
